recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸片中造血細胞非常稀少，背景多為紅血球，卻散布數個深紫色、緊密聚集的細胞團（箭頭），這種低倍下的「異常細胞團」是轉移性癌侵犯骨髓的第一個線索。
features: Multiple dense, dark purple cohesive cell clusters scattered across the smear (arrows)
Very scanty individual hematopoietic precursors between clusters
Background dominated by red cells with few fat droplets
Low magnification (x100) precludes assessment of individual cell cytology
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a paucicellular background composed mainly of red cells with very scanty scattered hematopoietic precursors. Numerous discrete, dark-staining cohesive cell clusters are distributed across the smear (arrows). The cytologic features of the clustered cells cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and high-power examination is needed to confirm their epithelial nature. In a patient with known breast adenocarcinoma, findings are suggestive of diffuse metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Marrow particles contain fat and a mixed hematopoietic population, and megakaryocytes are single large cells, whereas tumor clusters are tight groups of uniform large cells on high power.
Platelet aggregates are small, pale, granular and anucleate, while tumor clusters contain large nuclei.
Hemodilution also gives scant hematopoietic cells but lacks cohesive nucleated clusters; correlation with the core biopsy is required.
